request:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE full-body standalone illustration of the canonical Legacy FEMALE lioness in the attached identity master. The sheet shows several views of the SAME character. Output exactly one character; no sheet, labels, collage or graphic text.

Make just this performance change: she stands facing straight toward the viewer with her arms comfortably folded across her mid torso, a quiet confident closed-mouth expression, and weight resting lightly on one leg. Her face should use the FRONT BUST view's exact orientation and design, not an invented three-quarter face. Preserve the master’s eye size and almond silhouette, precise brow shape and spacing, small black feline nose, restrained narrow pale muzzle/whisker pads, cheek and chin construction, ears and golden wavy swept-back hair silhouette. The facial expression stays very close to the master. Do not make the eyes rounder/larger, widen the muzzle, add a human face, thicken brows, widen the jaw, or increase mane volume.

Preserve the master’s golden fur, exact athletic body proportions and head/body scale; same fitted plain black short-sleeve shirt, black trousers and black sneakers; one continuous slender golden lion tail with the canonical tuft. Maintain arm size and shoulder width; avoid exaggerated muscles. Folded arms must have coherent elbows, wrists and naturally placed hands. Show both feet and the full tail clearly with comfortable margins.

Style must remain the SAME semi-realistic illustrated mascot drawing as the reference: crisp confident contour lines, clean soft cel shading and subtle gradients modeling fur and form. No 3D plastic render, photoreal fur, generic Disney-like redesign or extra accessories. Warm ivory studio backdrop matching the reference; soft neutral light and subtle ground-contact shadow. 4:5 portrait composition, full figure at useful detail. No logo or lettering. Output the finished character only.
preserve: Front bust facial geometry, eye shape, muzzle width, hair volume, body scale and outfit
scope_boundary: One principal character; bounded, explicitly requested changes.
